implementation: Use existing owner-registered useSettingsDraft for server and platform fields, including LiveKit credentials and active saves.
Platform record selection/new/cancel confirmation pins account, auth generation and current draft. API writes are serialized; fields are disabled until completion.
Server acknowledgement updates only unchanged submitted fields; newer edits survive. Scope-keyed editor lifetimes clear secrets on account/server replacement.
Failed platform DELETE response does not remove local record or report success. No credentials are written to browser storage.
remaining_acceptance: Actual browser and installed Windows visual/focus/Escape interaction with unsaved confirmation
Full P0-P11 acceptance; other settings editors are not asserted complete
PR CI and deployment are separate gates; no merge, publication or installation performed
